experiment: Cache eight weight taps per lane across all 36 Winograd positions in a private half[72] array.
reason: The weight-cache experiment is correct on all six cases but materially slower. Private cache/register/local-memory pressure outweighs the reduced device-weight reads. No further small micro-optimization is justified.
cost_rationale: This stop is not driven by money or lack of budget. It is driven by diminishing and unstable technical returns: the remaining optimizations are small, the latest structural experiment is slower, and further time, engineering effort, validation burden, opportunity cost and optional model spend do not have a defensible expected return.
reliability_rationale: Reliable performance delivery is not a single lucky run. At microsecond scale, timing variance of several percent means an occasional result above 1.0x is not a stable speedup. A deliverable claim requires all correctness cases, matching candidate/build/evaluation identity, repeated independent fresh execution and the declared latency/noise gates. Research may continue, but a one-off win is not production evidence.
